meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按依赖顺序分阶段推进多步骤任务,出错可重试或修改后继续。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要让多个互有先后依赖的任务按序自动推进。
copy.tagline_en: Run dependent subtasks in phases, with retry and repair on failure.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to push groups of ordered tasks automatically.

howto.what: 把有先后依赖的子任务编成任务图,按波次并行执行:上游节点完成才启动下游节点。单个节点失败可重试、追加指令或修订定义,已完成的节点复用缓存结果。运行有日志记录,会话中断后重启会接着跑。
howto.when: 当你提到“mass-ulw”“任务 DAG”,或要做存在依赖的扇出工作(某些任务必须等其它任务先完成)时触发。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 把这个任务拆成依赖图来跑
say.note: 会先读完规划文档,再定义并启动运行。

say.text: 对这个图的 lint 节点重试,并把指令改成跳过 vendored 目录
say.note: 只有该节点重新跑,已完成节点用缓存。

say.text: 打开 /dag 给我看这次运行各节点的状态
say.note: 显示节点状态、波次和失败情况。

howto.what_en: Builds dependency-ordered subtasks into a DAG run in parallel waves: a node starts after its dependsOn nodes finish. Failed nodes can be retried, steered, or amended; finished nodes reuse cached results. Runs are journaled and resume after a restart.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for mass-ulw, a task DAG, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

say_en.text: Run mass-ulw to split this job into a dependency graph
say_en.note: It reads the planning reference before defining the graph.

say_en.text: Retry the lint node of this DAG and change its prompt to skip vendored dirs
say_en.note: Only that node re-runs; finished nodes reuse cache.

say_en.text: Open /dag and show me the node states of this run
say_en.note: Shows node states, waves, and failures.
